properties.description: Child pipeline — called by pl_bronze_api_master_v4 once per entity. Handles auth, watermark lookup, paginated copy, and audit write for ONE entity. All entity-specific values come in as parameters. Never triggered directly.

activities.name: act_get_username
activities.description: Read VoltGrid username from Key Vault using ADF Managed Identity.

activities.name: act_get_password
activities.description: Read VoltGrid password from Key Vault using ADF Managed Identity.

activities.name: act_api_login
activities.description: POST credentials to VoltGrid login. Token is shared across all entity calls in this run.

activities.name: act_set_ingestion_date
activities.description: Capture today UTC date once. Used as Bronze partition folder for all pages this entity run.

activities.name: act_get_watermark
activities.description: Lookup — reads bronze/audit/pipeline_audit_<entity_name>.csv which is a per-entity single-row watermark file. Each entity has its own file so firstRowOnly always returns the correct watermark for this entity. This avoids the multi-entity CSV firstRowOnly bug.

activities.name: act_set_watermark
activities.description: Full load: epoch constant. Incremental: use watermark_value from the per-entity audit CSV.

activities.name: act_get_total_pages
activities.description: Call page 1 of the parameterized entity API to read pagination.total_pages before the loop.

activities.name: act_paginate
activities.description: Loop through all pages of this entity until v_current_page exceeds v_total_pages.

activities.name: act_copy_entity_page
activities.description: Copy one page of entity data from REST API to Bronze ADLS. Source and sink paths are fully parameterized.

activities.name: act_set_status_success
activities.description: Mark this entity run as succeeded after the Until loop completes normally.

activities.name: act_set_status_failed
activities.description: Mark this entity run as failed if the Until loop or any upstream activity fails.

activities.name: act_write_audit
activities.description: Append one audit row to the shared pipeline_audit.csv. Always runs whether entity succeeded or failed.

activities.name: act_write_watermark
activities.description: Overwrite bronze/audit/watermark_<entity_name>.csv with a single row containing the current run_timestamp as the new watermark_value. Only runs on success so a failed run never advances the watermark. Next incremental run reads this file via ds_pipeline_audit_entity_csv to get the correct per-entity watermark.

properties.description: Master metadata-driven pipeline. Reads pipeline_metadata_config.json from Bronze ADLS, filters enabled=true entities, then calls pl_bronze_api_ingest_v4 (child pipeline) once per entity via ForEach. Adding a new entity = add one row to the config JSON, zero pipeline changes.

activities.name: act_read_metadata
activities.description: Lookup Activity — reads pipeline_metadata_config.json from Bronze ADLS. Returns the full JSON array of entity configs. firstRowOnly is false so all rows are returned in output.value array.

activities.name: act_foreach_entity
activities.description: Iterate over every enabled entity in the metadata config. isSequential is false — all entities run in parallel (max 20 concurrent). Each iteration calls the child pipeline with entity-specific parameters.

activities.name: act_ingest_entity
activities.description: Execute child pipeline for this entity. Passes entity_name, api_path, page_size, and load_type from metadata config and master pipeline parameter.

properties.description: Master pipeline v5 — extends v4 with Gold layer. Bronze (ForEach parallel) → Silver (Databricks notebook) → Gold (Databricks notebook). Adding a new entity = add one row to pipeline_metadata_config.json, zero pipeline changes.

activities.name: act_read_metadata
activities.description: Lookup Activity — reads pipeline_metadata_config.json from Bronze ADLS. Returns the full JSON array of entity configs. firstRowOnly is false so all rows are returned in output.value array.

activities.name: act_foreach_entity
activities.description: Iterate over every enabled entity in the metadata config. isSequential is false — all entities run in parallel (max 20 concurrent). Each iteration calls pl_bronze_api_ingest_v4 with entity-specific parameters.

activities.name: act_ingest_entity
activities.description: Execute Bronze child pipeline for this entity. Passes entity_name, api_path, page_size, and load_type from metadata config and master pipeline parameter.

activities.name: act_invoke_silver_pipeline
activities.description: Execute Silver transformation pipeline after all Bronze entities finish. Invokes pl_silver_api_transform_v4 which calls Databricks notebook 04_silver_all_entities_job_params_v4. Passes load_type and today ingestion_date. Only runs if ForEach succeeded.

activities.name: act_invoke_gold_pipeline
activities.description: Execute Gold transformation pipeline after Silver completes. Invokes pl_gold_api_transform_v4 which calls Databricks notebook 04_gold_full_incremental_v3. Passes load_type. Only runs if Silver succeeded — if Silver fails, Gold is automatically skipped.

properties.description: Day 2 — simple payments pipeline. Reads one page of VoltGrid API and stores raw JSON in Bronze. Authentication via Key Vault MSI. Pagination and incremental load added in Day 3.

Single-newline file with no columns and no header. Used as source in act_write_audit and act_write_watermark. firstRowAsHeader false, file contains only a newline so ADF reads exactly one empty row. All output columns come entirely from additionalColumns — no Prop_N clash.

Generic JSON sink dataset for all VoltGrid API entities. entity_name becomes the Bronze folder name. ingestion_date and page drive the partition path. One dataset replaces 18 entity-specific sink datasets.

Per-entity watermark CSV. Each entity has its own file at bronze/audit/watermark_<entity_name>.csv containing exactly one data row — the latest successful watermark for that entity. This fixes the firstRowOnly bug in the shared pipeline_audit.csv where all entities read the same row 1.

JSON dataset pointing to pipeline_metadata_config.json in Bronze ADLS. Read by act_read_metadata Lookup Activity in pl_bronze_api_master_v4 to get the list of all enabled entities. Upload pipeline_metadata_config.json to abfss://bronze@evdatalakedev.dfs.core.windows.net/config/pipeline_metadata_config.json before first run.

Generic REST source dataset for all VoltGrid API entities. Fully parameterized — api_path, page, page_size, and updated_after are all passed by the child pipeline pl_bronze_api_ingest_v4 at runtime. One dataset replaces 18 entity-specific datasets.
